name: create-person
description: Create a new person record with the specified first name, last name, email, and optional team ID. The first name and last name are required and must be between 1-255 characters. The email is required and must be a valid email format. The team ID is optional and must be a positive integer. Returns the newly created person with server-generated ID and timestamps. Requires authentication with a valid JWT token.

email.description: Person's email address (required, must be valid email format, unique)

teamId.description: ID of the team this person belongs to (optional, must be positive integer)

text.description: JSON string containing success status and created person data with ID and timestamps
